description: Collaborative work management platform for teams to track projects, tasks, and workflows.
auth_notes: Supports Personal Access Tokens (PATs) for quick/single-user scripts, Service Accounts (enterprise feature), and OAuth 2.0 for multi-user applications.
credential_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free Asana account and generate Personal Access Tokens or create OAuth apps directly in the developer console for free.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, custom fields, webhooks, attachments, users, and app components.
mcp_notes: Asana publishes official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementations (such as command-mcp and related repositories on their GitHub organisation).
rationale: The Asana API is fully public, well-documented, uses standard REST patterns, and provides immediate self-serve developer credential generation for free.

evidence.note: Documents Personal Access Tokens, Service Accounts, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.
Details access via the developer console and developer sandbox.
Describes the RESTful API base URL, endpoints, and resource schema.
Shows official Asana GitHub organization repositories including command-mcp.
